# seowatcher

> seowatcher (GitHub ve uygulama içi adı: seotracker), Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, kendi site tarayıcısı ve PageSpeed Insights verisini tek panelde toplayan ücretsiz, açık kaynaklı (MIT) bir SEO uygulamasıdır. Windows 10/11 (64 bit) için tek kurulum dosyası vardır; Mac ve Linux'ta Docker ile çalışır. Tek kullanıcılıdır, yalnızca kullanıcının kendi bilgisayarından erişilir, veri o bilgisayarda saklanır. Google, denetlenen siteler ve GitHub ile bağlantı kurar; isteğe bağlı yapay zekâ bağlantısı seçilen sağlayıcıya veri gönderebilir. Abonelik ve hesap yoktur. Arayüz dilleri: Türkçe, English, Deutsch, Français, Italiano, Português.
> English: seowatcher (also named seotracker) is a free, MIT-licensed, self-hosted SEO app that reads Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, its own crawler and PageSpeed Insights. Windows 10/11 installer; Docker on macOS/Linux. Single user, localhost only, data is stored on your machine. It connects to Google, audited sites and GitHub; optional AI integrations may send data to the selected provider. Derived from open-seo. The app's interface is available in 6 languages (Türkçe, English, Deutsch, Français, Italiano, Português); the website and this guide exist in Türkçe, English, Deutsch, Français, Italiano, Português.

Hızlı bilgiler: sürüm 0.8.7 Alpha, 202 denetim kuralı, yapay zekâ asistanları için 35 MCP aracı ve 6 hazır görev, fiyat 0, lisans MIT. Arama hacmi tahmini, backlink sayımı ve rakip sıralaması yoktur. Kurulum dosyası 86 MB, kurulu hali 313 MB; Visual C++ çalışma zamanı pakete dahildir.
Quick facts: version 0.8.7 Alpha, 202 audit rules, 35 MCP tools and 6 ready-made tasks for AI assistants, price 0, MIT license. No search-volume estimates, backlink counts or competitor rankings. Installer 86 MB, installed 313 MB; the Visual C++ runtime is bundled.

## Kılavuz: Başlangıç
- [seowatcher nedir?](https://seowatcher.io/kilavuz/seowatcher-nedir/): seowatcher; Search Console, GA4, site denetimi ve PageSpeed verisini bilgisayarınızda tek panelde toplayan ücretsiz, açık kaynaklı SEO uygulamasıdır.
- [Windows'a kurulum](https://seowatcher.io/kilavuz/kurulum-windows/): Windows'a tek dosyayla kurarsınız, Docker ya da terminal gerekmez. Güncelleme, kaldırma, yedek alma ve adres numarasını değiştirme de aynı sayfada.
- [Docker ile kurulum](https://seowatcher.io/kilavuz/kurulum-docker/): Mac, Linux ve Windows'ta Docker ile kurun. Tek komut yeter, .env dosyası gerekmez. Verileriniz Docker'ın veri deposunda durur.
- [Google'a bağlanma](https://seowatcher.io/kilavuz/google-baglantisi/): Search Console ve GA4'ü kendi Google Cloud hizmet hesabınız ya da OAuth istemcinizle bağlayın, sonra her proje için mülkleri seçin.
- [PageSpeed anahtarı](https://seowatcher.io/kilavuz/pagespeed-anahtari/): PageSpeed anahtarını kaydedin; test isteğinin ve denetim sayacının kapsamını öğrenin.

## Kılavuz: Ekranlar
- [Projeler](https://seowatcher.io/kilavuz/projeler/): Sitelerinizi projelerle yönetin. Her sitenin Search Console ve Analytics bağlantılarını, denetimlerini ve raporlarını ayrı inceleyin.
- [Panel](https://seowatcher.io/kilavuz/panel/): Panel, sitenin arama trafiğini, önce bakılacak ölçülmüş işleri ve kaynakların sınırlarını bir araya getirir.
- [Arama performansı](https://seowatcher.io/kilavuz/arama-performansi/): Search Console'dan tıklama, gösterim ve ortalama sırayı inceleyin. Önce düzeltilecek sayfaları ve kazanç tahminlerinin sınırlarını öğrenin.
- [Sıralama takibi](https://seowatcher.io/kilavuz/siralama-takibi/): Search Console sorgularının ortalama sırasını ve değişimini izleyin. Yerel arşivle Google'ın 16 aylık sınırından eski kayıtları inceleyin.
- [Fırsatlar](https://seowatcher.io/kilavuz/firsatlar/): Önce hangi sayfaya bakmalı? Google'da görünen sayfalarınız, Search Console verisinden hesaplanan ek tıklama üst sınırına ve önerilen işe göre sıralanır.
- [Kayıtlı kelimeler](https://seowatcher.io/kilavuz/kayitli-kelimeler/): Önemsediğiniz sorguların ortalama sırasını ve değişimini yerel Search Console arşivinden, tarihleriyle izleyin.
- [Analytics verisini yorumlama](https://seowatcher.io/kilavuz/analitik/): Bu ekran GA4 mülkünde ölçülen ziyaretleri, etkileşimi ve anahtar olayları gösterir.
- [Site denetimi](https://seowatcher.io/kilavuz/site-denetimi/): Sitenizi 202 kuralla denetleyin, sorunları önem sırasıyla inceleyin. Denetim puanını, ölçüm kapsamını ve eksik verilerin anlamını öğrenin.
- [Dizin durumu](https://seowatcher.io/kilavuz/dizin-durumu/): Google her sayfanızı dizine almış mı, almadıysa neden, en son ne zaman taramış? Google mülk başına günde 2.000 adres denetimine izin verir.
- [Raporlar ve şablonlar](https://seowatcher.io/kilavuz/raporlar/): Denetim, arama performansı ve asistan raporlarını tek HTML dosyasında saklayın. Raporları telefonda açın, yazdırın veya e-postayla paylaşın.
- [Proje bilgisi](https://seowatcher.io/kilavuz/proje-bilgisi/): İşinizi, hedefinizi ve önemli sayfalarınızı bir kez yazın; siz ve bağladığınız ajan aynı yerel notlardan çalışın.
- [Ayarlar](https://seowatcher.io/kilavuz/ayarlar/): Tema, dil, bildirimler, Google kimlikleri, PageSpeed anahtarı ve sürüm kontrolü; hangi ayar tarayıcıya, hangisi tüm kuruluma uygulanır.

## Kılavuz: Yardım ve başvuru
- [Yardım](https://seowatcher.io/kilavuz/yardim/): Bir şey ters giderse önce buraya bakın. Kurulumunuzu kontrol eder, sık sorunların çözümünü gösterir ve sorun bildirirken göndereceğiniz dosyayı hazırlar.
- [Denetim kuralları](https://seowatcher.io/kilavuz/denetim-kurallari/): Site denetiminin baktığı 202 kuralın tam listesi. Her kuralın ne demek olduğunu ve nasıl düzelteceğinizi buradan okursunuz.
- [Ajan kurulumu](https://seowatcher.io/kilavuz/ajan-kurulumu/): Ajanı güvenle bağlayın, yeni araç çağrısını doğrulayın ve SEO becerilerini kullanın.
- [Sorun giderme](https://seowatcher.io/kilavuz/sorun-giderme/): Windows uyarıları, Google bağlantı hataları, kota ve takılan denetimler için belirti, neden ve çözümü bulun. Boş grafik ve erişim sorunlarını giderin.
- [Sürüm notları](https://seowatcher.io/kilavuz/surum-notlari/): seowatcher 0.8.7 Alpha (29 Ekim 2026): 202 kurallı yeni site denetimi, altı dilli arayüz, bildirimler ve daha doğru Google verisi.

## Guide: Getting started
- [What is seowatcher?](https://seowatcher.io/en/docs/what-is-seowatcher/): A free, open-source SEO workspace that runs on your own computer and brings Search Console, GA4, a site audit and PageSpeed together.
- [Install on Windows](https://seowatcher.io/en/docs/install-windows/): Install seowatcher on Windows 10 or 11 with one file, then update, repair, back up, change the port or uninstall it. No Docker needed.
- [Install with Docker](https://seowatcher.io/en/docs/install-docker/): Run seowatcher in Docker on Mac, Linux or Windows with one command, then update, back up, configure or remove it.
- [Connecting to Google](https://seowatcher.io/en/docs/google-connection/): Give seowatcher read access to Search Console and GA4 with your own service account or OAuth client, then choose a property per project.
- [PageSpeed key](https://seowatcher.io/en/docs/pagespeed-key/): Create a free PageSpeed Insights API key, save it in Settings, test it and read the quota counters shown during site audits.

## Guide: Screens
- [Projects](https://seowatcher.io/en/docs/projects/): Create a project for each site, pick the one to work on, finish its connections and archive or restore projects without losing data.
- [Dashboard](https://seowatcher.io/en/docs/dashboard/): The project's starting screen: Google search totals, the next few tasks worth doing, the latest audit and organic traffic from GA4.
- [Search performance](https://seowatcher.io/en/docs/search-performance/): Clicks, impressions, CTR and position from Search Console, with a ranked to-do list, changes, overlaps and the queries behind every page.
- [Rank tracking](https://seowatcher.io/en/docs/rank-tracking/): Follow average Google positions for your Search Console queries over time, beyond Google's 16-month window, using the local archive.
- [Opportunities](https://seowatcher.io/en/docs/opportunities/): Which page to work on first. Pages Google already shows, ranked by an upper bound on extra clicks from your own Search Console data.
- [Saved keywords](https://seowatcher.io/en/docs/saved-keywords/): Follow the queries you care about with dated Search Console observations from the local archive, and see which ones moved.
- [Understanding Analytics data](https://seowatcher.io/en/docs/analytics/): Read GA4 sessions, engagement, key events and revenue for your site, check the measurement setup and export the rows you need.
- [Site audit](https://seowatcher.io/en/docs/site-audit/): Crawl your site, check it against the audit rules and work through the findings by priority, with a score that shows what was measured.
- [Index status](https://seowatcher.io/en/docs/index-status/): Ask Google whether each crawled page is indexed, why not, and when Google last crawled it, within the 2,000 daily URL Inspection quota.
- [Reports and templates](https://seowatcher.io/en/docs/reports/): Save search and audit reports as standalone HTML files, browse the library, print to PDF and keep templates for your assistant.
- [Project context](https://seowatcher.io/en/docs/project-context/): Write down what the business sells, its goal and its key pages, so you and a connected assistant work from the same notes.
- [Settings](https://seowatcher.io/en/docs/settings/): What each Settings section controls, which choices apply to this browser or the whole install, and where project settings live instead.

## Guide: Help and reference
- [Help](https://seowatcher.io/en/docs/help/): Check the installation's health, find fixes for common problems and download the diagnostics bundle to attach when you report an issue.
- [Audit rules](https://seowatcher.io/en/docs/audit-rules/): Every rule the site audit applies, with what each finding means, the first step to fix it and the rule ID used in exports.
- [Agent setup](https://seowatcher.io/en/docs/agent-setup/): Connect Claude Code, Codex or another MCP client to seowatcher, confirm it with a fresh tool call and install the six SEO skills.
- [Troubleshooting](https://seowatcher.io/en/docs/troubleshooting/): Symptom, cause and fix for the problems users hit most: port conflicts, Windows warnings, Google errors, quotas, audits and agent access.
- [Release notes](https://seowatcher.io/en/docs/release-notes/): seowatcher 0.8.7 Alpha (October 29, 2026): a new site audit with 202 rules, six interface languages, notifications and more accurate Google data.

## Anleitung: Erste Schritte
- [Was ist seowatcher?](https://seowatcher.io/de/dokumentation/was-ist-seowatcher/): seowatcher ist eine kostenlose Open-Source-SEO-App, die Search Console, GA4, Website-Audit und PageSpeed auf Ihrem eigenen Computer bündelt.
- [Installation unter Windows](https://seowatcher.io/de/dokumentation/installation-unter-windows/): seowatcher mit einer einzigen Datei installieren, ohne Docker und ohne Terminal. Dazu Update, Deinstallation, Sicherung und Portnummer.
- [Installation mit Docker](https://seowatcher.io/de/dokumentation/installation-mit-docker/): seowatcher mit Docker unter Mac, Linux und Windows installieren: ein Befehl, keine .env-Datei, die Daten liegen in einem Docker-Volume.
- [Mit Google verbinden](https://seowatcher.io/de/dokumentation/google-verbindung/): Search Console und GA4 mit eigenem Google-Cloud-Dienstkonto oder OAuth-Client verbinden und dann für jedes Projekt die Properties wählen.
- [PageSpeed-Schlüssel](https://seowatcher.io/de/dokumentation/pagespeed-schluessel/): Einen kostenlosen PageSpeed-Insights-Schlüssel anlegen und speichern und verstehen, was der Schlüsseltest und der Audit-Zähler aussagen.

## Anleitung: Bildschirme
- [Projekte](https://seowatcher.io/de/dokumentation/projekte/): Projekte listet Ihre Websites, zeigt fehlende Verbindungen und führt zur Arbeit. Jedes Projekt hat eigene Google-Properties, Audits und Berichte.
- [Übersicht](https://seowatcher.io/de/dokumentation/uebersicht/): Die Übersicht zeigt den Suchtraffic des Projekts, die nächsten belegten Aufgaben und die Grenzen jeder Datenquelle auf einen Blick.
- [Suchleistung](https://seowatcher.io/de/dokumentation/suchleistung/): Klicks, Impressionen und Positionen aus der Search Console verstehen. Seiten priorisieren und die Grenzen geschätzter Gewinne erkennen.
- [Ranking-Verfolgung](https://seowatcher.io/de/dokumentation/ranking-verfolgung/): Google-Positionen Ihrer Suchanfragen und deren Entwicklung verfolgen. Das lokale Archiv bewahrt Daten auch über die 16-Monate-Grenze hinaus.
- [Chancen](https://seowatcher.io/de/dokumentation/chancen/): Welche Seite zuerst? Seiten, die Google bereits zeigt, nach einer Obergrenze zusätzlicher Klicks aus Ihren Search-Console-Daten, mit Aufgabe.
- [Gespeicherte Keywords](https://seowatcher.io/de/dokumentation/gespeicherte-suchbegriffe/): Gespeicherte Keywords mit Zeitraum, Positionsänderung und Archivabdeckung aus Ihren eigenen Search-Console-Daten untersuchen.
- [Analytics-Daten verstehen](https://seowatcher.io/de/dokumentation/datenanalyse/): Analytics zeigt gemessene Besuche, Interaktionen und Schlüsselereignisse Ihrer GA4-Property neben den Suchdaten des Projekts.
- [Website-Audit](https://seowatcher.io/de/dokumentation/website-audit/): Ihre Website anhand von 202 Regeln prüfen und Probleme priorisieren. Punktzahl, Messabdeckung und unvollständige Ergebnisse richtig verstehen.
- [Indexstatus](https://seowatcher.io/de/dokumentation/indexstatus/): Ob Google Ihre Seiten indexiert hat, warum nicht und wann Google sie zuletzt gecrawlt hat. Höchstens 2.000 Abfragen pro Property und Tag.
- [Berichte und Vorlagen](https://seowatcher.io/de/dokumentation/berichte/): Audit-, Suchleistungs- und Agentenberichte als einzelne HTML-Dateien speichern, auf dem Smartphone öffnen, drucken oder per E-Mail teilen.
- [Projektkontext](https://seowatcher.io/de/dokumentation/projektinfo/): Der Projektkontext speichert lokale Notizen zu Ziel, Positionierung und wichtigen Seiten für Sie und verbundene KI-Agenten.
- [Einstellungen](https://seowatcher.io/de/dokumentation/einstellungen/): Was in den Einstellungen für den Browser, für die ganze Installation und für ein einzelnes Projekt gilt, und wo Sie es jeweils ändern.

## Anleitung: Hilfe und Nachschlagen
- [Hilfe](https://seowatcher.io/de/dokumentation/hilfe/): Der Bildschirm prüft Ihre Installation, zeigt Lösungen für häufige Probleme und bereitet die Datei für eine Problemmeldung vor.
- [Audit-Regeln](https://seowatcher.io/de/dokumentation/audit-regeln/): Die vollständige Liste der 202 Regeln, die das Website-Audit prüft. Hier lesen Sie zu jeder Regel, was sie bedeutet und wie Sie sie beheben.
- [Agent einrichten](https://seowatcher.io/de/dokumentation/assistent-einrichten/): KI-Agenten wie Claude Code oder Codex sicher über MCP verbinden, einen neuen Werkzeugaufruf bestätigen und die SEO-Skills nutzen.
- [Fehlerbehebung](https://seowatcher.io/de/dokumentation/fehlerbehebung/): Häufige Probleme mit Symptom, Ursache und Lösung: Port, Windows-Warnung, Google-Fehler, Kontingent, hängendes Audit, leere Diagramme, Agent 401.
- [Versionshinweise](https://seowatcher.io/de/dokumentation/versionshinweise/): seowatcher 0.8.7 Alpha (29. Oktober 2026): neues Website-Audit mit 202 Regeln, sechs Sprachen, Benachrichtigungen und genauere Google-Daten.

## Guide: Pour démarrer
- [Qu’est-ce que seowatcher ?](https://seowatcher.io/fr/guides/quest-ce-que-seowatcher/): seowatcher est une application SEO gratuite et open source qui réunit Search Console, GA4, audit de site et PageSpeed sur votre propre ordinateur.
- [Installation sous Windows](https://seowatcher.io/fr/guides/installation-sous-windows/): Installez l’application sous Windows avec un seul fichier : premier lancement, mise à jour, désinstallation, sauvegarde et port. Ni Docker ni terminal.
- [Installation avec Docker](https://seowatcher.io/fr/guides/installation-avec-docker/): Installez l’application avec Docker sur Mac, Linux et Windows. Une seule commande, sans fichier .env. Vos données restent dans le volume Docker.
- [Connexion à Google](https://seowatcher.io/fr/guides/connexion-google/): Connectez Search Console et GA4 avec votre compte de service Google Cloud ou votre client OAuth, puis choisissez les propriétés de chaque projet.
- [Clé PageSpeed](https://seowatcher.io/fr/guides/cle-pagespeed/): Créer une clé d’API PageSpeed Insights gratuite, l’enregistrer dans Paramètres, la tester et lire les compteurs de quota des audits.

## Guide: Les écrans
- [Projets](https://seowatcher.io/fr/guides/projets/): Projets aide à choisir un site et à compléter ses connexions. Chaque projet conserve ses propriétés Google, audits et rapports.
- [Tableau de bord](https://seowatcher.io/fr/guides/tableau-de-bord/): Le tableau de bord résume un projet : trafic de recherche, étapes suivantes étayées, dernier audit du site et trafic organique Analytics.
- [Performances de recherche](https://seowatcher.io/fr/guides/performance-de-recherche/): Comprendre clics, impressions et positions dans Search Console. Prioriser les pages à corriger et lire les limites des gains estimés.
- [Suivi des classements](https://seowatcher.io/fr/guides/suivi-du-classement/): Suivre les positions moyennes Google de vos requêtes et leur évolution. L’archive locale conserve les données au-delà de la limite de 16 mois.
- [Opportunités](https://seowatcher.io/fr/guides/opportunites/): Quelle page travailler d’abord ? Vos pages visibles dans Google, classées par plafond de clics supplémentaires, avec le travail suggéré.
- [Mots-clés enregistrés](https://seowatcher.io/fr/guides/mots-cles-enregistres/): Suivre vos mots-clés enregistrés avec les observations datées de l’archive Search Console locale, leur évolution de position et leur couverture.
- [Comprendre les données Analytics](https://seowatcher.io/fr/guides/statistiques/): Analytics présente les visites, l’engagement et les événements clés mesurés dans votre propriété GA4.
- [Audit du site](https://seowatcher.io/fr/guides/audit-du-site/): Vérifier votre site avec 202 règles et traiter les problèmes par priorité. Comprendre le score, la couverture des mesures et les résultats incomplets.
- [État de l’indexation](https://seowatcher.io/fr/guides/etat-de-l-index/): Google a-t-il indexé chacune de vos pages, sinon pourquoi, et quand l’a-t-il explorée pour la dernière fois ? Jusqu’à 2 000 pages vérifiées par jour.
- [Rapports et modèles](https://seowatcher.io/fr/guides/rapports/): Conserver les rapports d’audit, de recherche et de votre assistant en fichiers HTML. Les ouvrir sur mobile, les imprimer ou les partager par e-mail.
- [Contexte du projet](https://seowatcher.io/fr/guides/infos-du-projet/): Conserver les objectifs et les notes du projet en local pour vous et votre assistant connecté. Comprendre leur portée et leurs limites.
- [Paramètres](https://seowatcher.io/fr/guides/parametres/): Ce que règle chaque section des Paramètres, pour ce navigateur ou toute l’installation : langue, identifiants Google, PageSpeed, limites et versions.

## Guide: Aide et référence
- [Aide](https://seowatcher.io/fr/guides/aide/): En cas de souci, commencez ici : l’écran vérifie l’installation, donne la solution aux problèmes courants et prépare le fichier à joindre au signalement.
- [Règles d’audit](https://seowatcher.io/fr/guides/regles-d-audit/): La liste complète des 202 règles de l’audit du site. Pour chacune : ce qu’elle signifie et comment la corriger.
- [Configuration de l’agent](https://seowatcher.io/fr/guides/installation-assistant/): Connecter votre assistant SEO sans exposer le jeton, vérifier un nouvel appel et utiliser les compétences pour auditer le site et rédiger un rapport.
- [Dépannage](https://seowatcher.io/fr/guides/depannage/): Problèmes fréquents par symptôme, cause et solution : port occupé, alerte Windows, erreurs Google, quota, audit bloqué, graphiques vides, assistant 401.
- [Notes de version](https://seowatcher.io/fr/guides/notes-de-version/): seowatcher 0.8.7 Alpha (29 octobre 2026) : nouvel audit de site à 202 règles, six langues, notifications et données Google plus exactes.

## Guida: Per iniziare
- [Che cos'è seowatcher?](https://seowatcher.io/it/guide/cos-e-seowatcher/): seowatcher è un'app SEO gratuita e open source che riunisce Search Console, GA4, controllo del sito e PageSpeed sul Suo computer.
- [Installazione su Windows](https://seowatcher.io/it/guide/installazione-su-windows/): Si installa su Windows con un solo file, senza Docker né terminale. Nella stessa pagina: aggiornamento, disinstallazione, copia di sicurezza, porta.
- [Installazione con Docker](https://seowatcher.io/it/guide/installazione-con-docker/): Si installa con Docker su Mac, Linux e Windows. Basta un solo comando e non serve il file .env. I dati restano nel volume di dati di Docker.
- [Collegamento con Google](https://seowatcher.io/it/guide/collegamento-google/): Collegare Search Console e GA4 con un account di servizio Google Cloud o un client OAuth, poi scegliere le proprietà di ogni progetto.
- [Chiave PageSpeed](https://seowatcher.io/it/guide/chiave-pagespeed/): Salvare la chiave API di PageSpeed Insights, interpretare la prova della chiave e capire quote e contatori del controllo del sito.

## Guida: Schermate
- [Progetti](https://seowatcher.io/it/guide/progetti/): Progetti elenca i siti monitorati e indica le connessioni mancanti. Ogni progetto ha proprietà Google, controlli e report propri.
- [Pannello](https://seowatcher.io/it/guide/pannello/): Il Pannello riunisce traffico di ricerca, prossime attività basate sui dati, stato del controllo e risultati Analytics del progetto.
- [Rendimento della ricerca](https://seowatcher.io/it/guide/prestazioni-di-ricerca/): Leggere clic, impressioni e posizioni da Search Console. Scegliere le pagine da migliorare e capire i limiti dei guadagni stimati.
- [Monitoraggio del posizionamento](https://seowatcher.io/it/guide/monitoraggio-posizioni/): Seguire la posizione media su Google delle query e le sue variazioni. L'archivio locale conserva i dati oltre i 16 mesi di Search Console.
- [Opportunità](https://seowatcher.io/it/guide/opportunita/): Quale pagina curare prima: le pagine già visibili su Google, ordinate per clic aggiuntivi massimi secondo Search Console, con il lavoro suggerito.
- [Parole chiave salvate](https://seowatcher.io/it/guide/parole-chiave-salvate/): Seguire le parole chiave salvate nell'archivio locale: periodi, osservazioni, dati mancanti, variazioni di posizione ed esportazione.
- [Capire i dati di Analytics](https://seowatcher.io/it/guide/analisi/): Leggere sessioni, coinvolgimento, eventi chiave ed entrate GA4 del sito, controllare la misurazione ed esportare le righe necessarie.
- [Controllo del sito](https://seowatcher.io/it/guide/controllo-del-sito/): Controllare il sito con 202 regole e ordinare i problemi per priorità. Capire il punteggio, la copertura delle misure e i risultati incompleti.
- [Stato dell'indicizzazione](https://seowatcher.io/it/guide/stato-indice/): Google ha inserito ogni pagina nell'indice? Se no, perché, e quando l'ha scansionata l'ultima volta? Al massimo 2.000 richieste al giorno.
- [Report e modelli](https://seowatcher.io/it/guide/rapporti/): Salvare report di ricerca, controllo e agente come file HTML singoli, ritrovarli, stamparli in PDF e condividerli; modelli e limiti.
- [Contesto del progetto](https://seowatcher.io/it/guide/informazioni-progetto/): Contesto del progetto conserva in locale obiettivi, concorrenti e note che Lei e un agente collegato possono usare. Limiti e salvataggio.
- [Impostazioni](https://seowatcher.io/it/guide/impostazioni/): Che cosa vale per il browser, per l'installazione o per il progetto: lingua, credenziali Google, chiave PageSpeed, limiti, aggiornamenti.

## Guida: Aiuto e riferimento
- [Aiuto](https://seowatcher.io/it/guide/aiuto/): Il primo posto da controllare quando qualcosa non funziona: stato dell'installazione, problemi comuni e pacchetto diagnostico.
- [Regole del controllo](https://seowatcher.io/it/guide/regole-del-controllo/): L'elenco completo delle 202 regole che il controllo del sito verifica. Qui si legge che cosa significa ogni regola e come correggerla.
- [Configurazione dell'agente](https://seowatcher.io/it/guide/configurazione-assistente/): Collegare un agente IA a seowatcher tramite MCP, verificare la connessione, proteggere il token e usare le skill per controlli e report.
- [Risoluzione dei problemi](https://seowatcher.io/it/guide/risoluzione-problemi/): I problemi più comuni, con sintomo, causa e soluzione: porta occupata, avviso di Windows, errori di Google, quota, controllo bloccato, agente 401.
- [Note di versione](https://seowatcher.io/it/guide/note-di-rilascio/): seowatcher 0.8.7 Alpha (29 ottobre 2026): nuovo controllo del sito con 202 regole, sei lingue, notifiche e dati Google più precisi.

## Guia: Primeiros passos
- [O que é o seowatcher?](https://seowatcher.io/pt/guias/o-que-e-seowatcher/): O seowatcher é um app de SEO gratuito e de código aberto que reúne Search Console, GA4, auditoria do site e PageSpeed no seu computador.
- [Instalar no Windows](https://seowatcher.io/pt/guias/instalar-no-windows/): Instale no Windows com um único arquivo: primeira abertura, atualização, desinstalação, backup e troca da porta. Sem Docker e sem terminal.
- [Instalar com Docker](https://seowatcher.io/pt/guias/instalar-com-docker/): Instale com Docker no Mac, no Linux e no Windows. Um comando basta e não é preciso criar um arquivo .env. Seus dados ficam no volume de dados do Docker.
- [Conectar ao Google](https://seowatcher.io/pt/guias/conexao-google/): Como conectar o Search Console e o GA4 com uma conta de serviço do Google Cloud ou um cliente OAuth e escolher as propriedades de cada projeto.
- [Chave do PageSpeed](https://seowatcher.io/pt/guias/chave-pagespeed/): Como salvar a chave da API do PageSpeed Insights, entender o teste da chave e acompanhar cotas e contadores da auditoria do site.

## Guia: Telas
- [Projetos](https://seowatcher.io/pt/guias/projetos/): Projetos lista os sites acompanhados e mostra as conexões que faltam. Cada projeto tem propriedades Google, auditorias e relatórios próprios.
- [Painel](https://seowatcher.io/pt/guias/painel/): O Painel reúne tráfego de pesquisa, próximas tarefas baseadas em dados, situação da auditoria e resultados do Analytics do projeto.
- [Desempenho da pesquisa](https://seowatcher.io/pt/guias/desempenho-de-busca/): Cliques, impressões e posições do Search Console, as páginas a melhorar primeiro e os limites dos ganhos estimados.
- [Acompanhamento de posições](https://seowatcher.io/pt/guias/acompanhamento-de-posicoes/): Acompanhe a posição média das consultas no Google e suas variações. O arquivo local guarda os dados além dos 16 meses do Search Console.
- [Oportunidades](https://seowatcher.io/pt/guias/oportunidades/): Qual página trabalhar primeiro: páginas que o Google já mostra, ordenadas pelo máximo de cliques extras do Search Console, com o trabalho sugerido.
- [Palavras-chave salvas](https://seowatcher.io/pt/guias/palavras-chave-salvas/): Como acompanhar as palavras-chave salvas no arquivo local: períodos, observações, dados ausentes, variações de posição e exportação.
- [Compreender os dados do Analytics](https://seowatcher.io/pt/guias/analise/): Como ler sessões, engajamento, eventos principais e receita do GA4 do site, verificar a medição e exportar as linhas necessárias.
- [Auditoria do site](https://seowatcher.io/pt/guias/auditoria-do-site/): Confira seu site com 202 regras e priorize os problemas. Entenda a pontuação da auditoria, a cobertura das medições e os resultados incompletos.
- [Status de indexação](https://seowatcher.io/pt/guias/status-de-indexacao/): O Google colocou cada página no índice? Se não, por quê, e quando ele a rastreou pela última vez? No máximo 2.000 consultas por dia.
- [Relatórios e modelos](https://seowatcher.io/pt/guias/relatorios/): Salve relatórios de pesquisa, auditoria e do agente como arquivos HTML, encontre-os, imprima em PDF e compartilhe; modelos e limites.
- [Contexto do projeto](https://seowatcher.io/pt/guias/informacoes-do-projeto/): Contexto do projeto guarda localmente metas, concorrentes e notas que você e um agente conectado podem usar. Limites e gravação.
- [Configurações](https://seowatcher.io/pt/guias/configuracoes/): O que vale para o navegador, para a instalação ou para o projeto: idioma, credenciais do Google, chave do PageSpeed, limites e atualizações.

## Guia: Ajuda e referência
- [Ajuda](https://seowatcher.io/pt/guias/ajuda/): O primeiro lugar a conferir quando algo não funciona: status da instalação, problemas comuns e pacote de diagnóstico para relatar falhas.
- [Regras de auditoria](https://seowatcher.io/pt/guias/regras-de-auditoria/): A lista das 202 regras que a auditoria do site confere. Para cada regra, você encontra o que ela significa e como corrigir.
- [Configuração do agente](https://seowatcher.io/pt/guias/configurar-agente/): Como conectar um agente de IA ao seowatcher por MCP, verificar a conexão, proteger o token e usar as skills em auditorias e relatórios.
- [Solução de problemas](https://seowatcher.io/pt/guias/solucao-de-problemas/): Problemas mais comuns, com sintoma, causa e solução: porta em uso, aviso do Windows, erros do Google, cota, auditoria travada, gráficos vazios, erro 401.
- [Notas da versão](https://seowatcher.io/pt/guias/notas-da-versao/): seowatcher 0.8.7 Alpha (29 de outubro de 2026): nova auditoria do site com 202 regras, seis idiomas, notificações e dados do Google mais precisos.
